text: 研究指IES喺正確率低過 90% 嗰陣唔啱用；不過「見到呢個刺激要撳呢個掣」並唔係複雜嘅工作，所以多數情況下正確率都過到 90%。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Fictional stories, such as in fantasy genre and sci-fi genre, are not "lying." They are literary and cinematic art forms. Ancient peoples such the Australian Aborigines and Red Indians transmitted oral traditional animistic stories from one generation to another. The line between reality and irreality became blurred. The Japanese have a wider scope than Westerners about reality, irreality, and "betwixt."

jyutping: heoi1 kau3 gu3 si6，lai6 jyu4 kei4 waan6 leoi6 jing4 tung4 fo1 waan6 leoi6 jing4，dou1 m4 hai6「gong2 daai6 waa6」。keoi5 dei6 hai6 man4 hok6 tung4 din6 jing2 ngai6 seot6 jing4 sik1。gu2 doi6 man4 zuk6，lai6 jyu4 ou3 zau1 jyun4 zyu6 man4 tung4 hung4 jan3 dai6 on1 jan4，zoeng1 cyun4 tung2 ge3 maan6 mat6 jau5 ling4 gu3 si6 jau4 jat1 doi6 cyun4 dou3 ling6 jat1 doi6。jin6 sat6 tung4 fei1 jin6 sat6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gaai3 sin3 bin3 dak1 mou4 wu4。jat6 bun2 jan4 deoi3 jin6 sat6、fei1 jin6 sat6 sing3 tung4「zung1 gaan1」ge3 jing6 sik1 gang1 gwong2 faan3 gwo3 sai1 fong1 jan4。
text: 虛構故事，例如奇幻類型同科幻類型，都唔係「講大話」。佢哋係文學同電影藝術形式。古代民族，例如澳洲原住民同紅印第安人，將傳統嘅萬物有靈故事由一代傳到另一代。現實同非現實之間嘅界線變得模糊。日本人對現實、非現實性同「中間」嘅認識更廣泛過西方人。
